concern_results.conclusion: No P0/P1 bypass found. guard-merge: platform merge arms never read branch globals. The git branch context now loads only for push/merge/pull, which are the only subcommands the later case evaluates. is_default_name fills the context lazily when seg_git_loaded=0. The post-loop warning reads base_* after ensure_base_git_context, so the while-loop subshell does not lose state; it may only repeat a few git calls. skill-loading: may_write_from_bash covers '>', backslash, quote-stripped write verbs, shells and interpreters at shell boundaries. The non-matching cases also return no targets in bash_write_targets, but this relies on INTERPRETER (not shown) being covered by python/node/ruby. owner-dispatch fast path: it applies only with no tool override, input <=64KiB, no config ancestor of $PWD, and no backslash or edit/write/apply_patch text. Without a backslash, JSON escapes cannot hide a tool name. agy-bridge: run_hook already strips CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT, so the skipped hook was already inert. The scratch exclusion in host-input only affects advisory reader_docs.

Containment holds within this partition. The merge guard still denies through DENY_GIT, DENY_GIT_UNRESOLVED and DENY_MR. The new tests cover the release default branch and the case of cd into a sub-repo with an unset origin. Fail-closed handling of the owner-dispatch edit tools is unchanged, because any edit/write/apply_patch text forces the jq path. R0 stamp permissions, waived spec citations and nested-export size-budget code are not in this partition's diff, so I could not check them here.
